description: 河川分署遠端監控影像 [dams, reservoirs and flood defences] is a dataset listed in Government Open Data Platform of Taiwan (data.gov.tw), an open data portal, published or maintained by 經濟部水利署. 本資料集為水利署各河川分署流域與疏濬工區遠端監控影像。 本資料集係彙整水利署河川分署各疏濬工區設置之管制站之監控影像，藉由管制站監控疏濬工區，使保全人員與巡防駐衛警能即時掌握狀況，以防犯疏濬工區範圍內在「非作業時段出料」之違法行為、砂石車出場時確實加蓋防塵網以符合環保規範等；另外，砂石車在疏濬工區若大排長龍，則導致交通問題。 透過影像與其... Coverage: Taiwan. The portal files it under the publisher 經濟部水利署. Its tags are 公共資訊. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv, json, xml. The portal shows 2026-09-19 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Chinese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is 政府資料開放授權條款-第1版. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support flood defence and reservoir studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-tw-dgt-portal.
